Carbon Limits AS (2021). Zero emission technologies for pneumatic controllers in the USA: Updated applicability and cost effectiveness. Final, November 2021. Prepared for Clean Air Task Force (CATF); project leader Malavika Venugopal, with Stephanie Saunier. Oslo: Carbon Limits AS. Submitted to regulations.gov docket EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-0845, attachment 1.

Region: USA (Canadian regulation context discussed). Annex-update to Carbon Limits 2016 (carbon-limits_2016_001). Page numbers are printed: front matter roman (i-iv), body arabic 1-17, appendix roman i-v; these differ from PDF pages. Loaded: incremental CAPEX (incl. installation, rounded to 1,000 USD) and NPV CH4 abatement cost for three sample sites (A: 3+2+1 ESD, B: 5+5+1, C: 10+10+2) across new/retrofit, grid/off-grid and existing/new-valve configurations for solar electric controllers, grid electric controllers, grid instrument air and solar instrument air (Tables 7-9, 28 examples); electric controller and pump unit costs; solar instrument air compressor package costs by HP with lifetime and maintenance. Other-values: 2016-model abatement costs inflated to 2021 (printed alongside), annualised ranges (Table 10), component costs (panels, batteries, fuel cell, FSC+UPS, labour), engineering assumptions, sensitivity results, social cost of methane. Not loaded: figures 3-4 (charts), descriptive literature review. Traps: (1) no price year printed; treated as 2021 USD (2016 values inflated by 10.15% to the present). (2) Controller cost 2,000 USD in Table 2 but 1,500 in Table A.1; control panel 5,000 in Table 2 but 4,000 in Table A.1. (3) Retrofit remaining lifetime 15 years in Table 6 versus 10 in 2016 although Table 6 claims assumptions are the same as 2016. (4) Table 3 prints the 15 HP compressor unit as $15,00 (Table A.1: 15,000). (5) Table 10 solar instrument air range for site C printed 270-226 (reversed) and Table 9 leaves solar instrument air cells blank. (6) Emission factors (14.43/4.43/13.3/0.41 scfh) and grid instrument air and baseline costs are unchanged from 2016 and were not re-extracted. SUPERSESSION: this report supersedes the 2016 report for electric controller costs and abatement costs (about 30% lower for new sites) and adds solar instrument air; the 2016 report remains the source for grid instrument air costs, baseline gas-driven device costs and emission factors.
